chunks: And from him, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad:

key_terms.الْعَلَاءِ: al-ʿAlāʾ, a narrator in the sanad
key_terms.فَضَالَةَ: Faḍālah, a narrator in the sanad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٍ: Muḥammad, the final named narrator in this chain segment
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: Its like; meaning the matn is the same as the preceding narration
key_terms.وَعَنْهُ: And from him; indicates continuation of transmission from a previous narrator

ai.seo_question: What does a hadith mean when it says “مِثْلَهُ” after the narrator chain?
ai.summary: This report contains a narrator chain followed by a brief indication that the text is the same as the preceding hadith. It functions as a supporting transmission for the same legal ruling discussed earlier in the chapter regarding what clothing and places are permissible for salat (prayer).
